note: Curated premium color + gradient system for Karim/Calaf — quality over volume. Dark + light foundations, AI violet/blue/cyan accent system, warm-luxury alt, WCAG-aware CTA contrast.

palettes.name: Obsidian AI — dark foundation
palettes.gradient: none — flat accent-tinted near-black; depth via lighter surfaces, not shadows
palettes.usage: Default dark base for AI/futuristic builds. Cool near-black harmonizes with violet accent; never #121212, never #000.

palettes.name: Warm Paper — light foundation
palettes.gradient: none — flat warm off-white, no aurora/mesh behind type
palettes.usage: Promoted from od-tpl-orbit-general. Default clean light base for dashboards/editorial. Whitespace is the only atmosphere.

palettes.name: Spectrum Accent — violet/blue/cyan family
palettes.contrastNote: Chrome commits to ONE stop (violet #7C5CFF). Cyan is hover/live-only. Light mode uses #6B4AE6 for AA on white.
palettes.usage: The AI identity. Full sweep lives only in gradients/glows; one stop drives all interactive chrome.

palettes.name: Primary CTA — tonal violet fill
palettes.contrastNote: White ink verified against the DARKEST stop #6B4AE6 ≈ 4.9:1 (AA PASS). Same-hue ramp gives depth without slop.
palettes.usage: One primary CTA per viewport. Secondary actions are ghost/outline. Focus ring 2px violet + glow halo.

palettes.name: Aurora Hero Wash
palettes.gradient: radial-gradient(120% 80% at 20% 0%, #7C5CFF26 0%, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(100% 70% at 90% 20%, #38E1D81F 0%, transparent 55%), #0A0A0F
palettes.contrastNote: Low-chroma (15-26% alpha) field BEHIND type only. Text sits on near-opaque base region; verify ≥4.5:1 where text lands.
palettes.usage: Hero background field. Same-family glow, scoped to one surface. Never put text on the bright zones.

palettes.name: Frosted Glass Card
palettes.contrastNote: Decorative depth only — never the contrast surface for body text. Place text on --surface-1 instead.
palettes.usage: Cinematic frosted nav/card over dark or imagery. Premium depth without a drop shadow.

palettes.name: Scoped Launch Hero (Binance pattern)
palettes.contrastNote: Named one-off token. White headline on the violet third ≈ 3.4:1 — use large/bold (≥24px) only, or shift text to the dark third.
palettes.usage: A single named launch/announcement surface. Explicitly prohibited from generalizing across the product.

palettes.name: Atelier Gold — warm-luxury foundation+accent
palettes.gradient: radial-gradient(90% 60% at 50% 30%, #C9A86A26 0%, #FFB47714 40%, transparent 70%) — warm radial only, never linear
palettes.contrastNote: #F2EBE0 on #14100C ≈ 15.9:1 (AAA). Champagne #C9A86A on #14100C ≈ 7.8:1 — accent/heading, not body.
palettes.usage: The non-AI brief: luxury/editorial/hospitality. Desaturated champagne gold, never #FFD700. One cool utility secondary max.

palettes.name: Espresso CTA — gold on dark
palettes.contrastNote: Dark ink #14100C on gold #C9A86A ≈ 7.2:1 (AAA) — luxury CTAs use DARK ink on gold, not white.
palettes.usage: Primary action for the warm-luxury system. Dark-ink-on-gold reads premium; white-on-gold fails and looks cheap.

palettes.name: Status Signals — brand-independent semantics
palettes.gradient: none — flat semantic fills, explicit hex (no rgba alpha-stacking)
palettes.contrastNote: Dark trio (#2FB36B/#E0A93A/#E5564B) on #0A0A0F all ≥4.6:1. Light trio on #FAFAF8 all ≥3.6:1 (use dark ink for body).
palettes.usage: success/warn/danger kept OUTSIDE the violet spectrum so danger never reads as accent. Derive once, reuse as tokens.
